atomone.manual_upgrade:
cd $HOME
rm -rf atomone
git clone https://github.com/atomone-hub/atomone.git
cd atomone
git checkout v3.0.3
make install
sudo systemctl restart atomoned && sudo journalctl -fu atomoned -o cat

terra.manual_upgrade:
cd $HOME
rm -rf terra
git clone https://github.com/terra-money/core.git
cd terra
git checkout v2.3.0
make install
sudo systemctl restart terrad && sudo journalctl -fu terrad -o cat
